units.source_text: 如今神明已容汝返都，还有何借口回避我？

en.t: Now that the gods have allowed you to return to the capital, what excuse can you still have for avoiding me?

units.source_text: 我自惨遭谪戍，历尽艰辛之后，种种忧恼，积集胸中，极想向你申诉一二呢。”

en.t: Since I was cruelly sent into exile and endured every hardship, all sorts of grief and anxiety have built up in my heart, and I long to tell you at least a little of it."

units.source_text: 那殷勤恳切之状，比从前更加优美潇洒了。

en.t: His earnest and attentive manner had become even more graceful and elegant than before.

units.source_text: 他年纪虽然大了些，但从内大臣这职位来说，颇不相称，过于年轻了。

en.t: Although he was somewhat older now, for the office of Minister of the Center he still seemed rather unsuited to it, far too young.
